description: Full-body native pixel-art game sprite, STRICTLY FRONT SOUTH view: face, nose, chest, belt and knees directly toward viewer, both ears equally visible. No sideways head or three-quarter turn. IDENTITY: Adult man with moderately broad shoulders, lean firm torso, long angular clean-shaven face, strong jaw and flat unimpressed mouth. Short dark brown-black hair swept back with a shallow side part and small lifted tufts, short sides. Black aviator sunglasses. Dark charcoal-brown tailored suit, white shirt, correctly tied black tie, sleeves down. No scars, beard, cigarette or handheld device in this default appearance. Relaxed upright stance, empty hands at sides. Natural adult anatomy, normal torso/pelvis, 7-head proportions. Anatomical crown to soles 214-222px; feet 6px above bottom, hair fully inside frame. Crisp single-pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained game-sprite shading, no antialiasing. Transparent background, no ground shadow, text or weapons. Preserve individual hair, face, stature and clothing. Do not copy any generic character. Anatomical height excludes high hair/headwear. Every outer edge must border transparency directly, never a light gray halo. Use target anatomical height at reference pixel scale. Feet at y250, crown around y32. Do not copy reference identity or body fat.
